query:
UPDATE platforms
         SET name = ?1, abbreviation = ?2, category = ?3, active = ?4, slug = COALESCE(?6, slug),
             sort_order = CASE WHEN ?4 AND NOT active
                 THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 10 FROM platforms WHERE active)
                 ELSE sort_order END
         WHERE id = ?5
